ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in Siberia changed by +0.448 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.370 to +0.526), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 1.105 °C.

ranking.name: Water in the topsoil
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water in the topsoil in Siberia shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.16): the estimate is −0.08 kg/m² per decade (95% confidence interval −0.19 to +0.03). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
